scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@trail-pm/cli && npm run build --workspace=@trail-pm/ui
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build --workspace=@trail/ipc && npm run build --workspace=@trail/core && npm run build --workspace=@trail/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@trail-pm/cli && npm run test --workspace=@trail/core && npm run test --workspace=@trail/ipc && npm run test --workspace=@trail/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@trail-pm/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@trail/core --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=@trail/ipc --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=@trail/desktop --if-present
scripts.ui:prepare: npm run build --workspace=@trail-pm/cli && npm run build --workspace=@trail-pm/ui
scripts.ui:dev: npm run build --workspace=@trail-pm/cli && npm --prefix packages/ui run dev:all
scripts.trail-ui: npm run ui:prepare && npm --prefix packages/ui exec trail-ui
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build --workspace=@trail/ipc && npm run build --workspace=@trail/core && npm run dev --workspace=@trail/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist --workspace=@trail/desktop
